title: Paloma Rewards Program Terms: One Membership per Customer and Re-enrollment
content:
A customer may hold at most 1 Paloma Rewards membership.

## Clauses

1. **One membership.** A customer may hold at most one Paloma Rewards membership. Enrollment is accepted only when the customer holds no other membership whose status is active or suspended.
2. **Rejoining after an opt-out.** A customer who opted out may enroll again only once the rejoin wait (a number of calendar days set per tier) has passed since the opt-out, and starts with no points.
3. **Counting the wait.** The wait is counted in calendar days from the closing date of the opted-out membership, and enrollment on the closing date plus the rejoin wait is allowed. Enrollment is therefore permitted on any date not earlier than that day, and not permitted before it.
4. **Termination for abuse.** A customer whose membership was terminated for abuse may not enroll again.

## Basis of the checks

Each of these clauses is judged on Paloma's own membership records for the same customer, as they stand before the enrollment is made: the status of each membership the customer holds, and, for a closed membership, its closing date and its closure reason (an opt-out, abuse, or the closure of the Personal Sender Account). What the customer says about an earlier membership does not replace those records.

## Judgement table

| What the customer's membership records show | Effect on a new enrollment |
|---|---|
| A membership with status active | Not accepted (clause 1) |
| A membership with status suspended | Not accepted (clause 1) |
| A membership closed by opt-out, enrollment date earlier than the closing date plus the rejoin wait | Not accepted (clauses 2 and 3) |
| A membership closed by opt-out, enrollment date on or after the closing date plus the rejoin wait | This clause set does not stand in the way; the new membership starts with no points |
| A membership terminated for abuse | Not accepted, at any time (clause 4) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, with a rejoin wait of 90 calendar days)

- Opt-out closing date 10 January 2026. Counting 90 calendar days from that date gives 10 April 2026. Enrollment on 10 April 2026 is allowed; enrollment on 9 April 2026 is not.
- The points held on the earlier membership do not come back: the new membership starts at zero points whatever the earlier balance was.
